meta.name: The Royals 720p
meta.description: Drama about a fictional British Royal family set in modern day London, who inhabit a world of opulence and regal tradition that caters to any and every desire, but one that also comes with a price tag of duty, destiny and intense public scrutiny.

videos.title: Stand and Unfold Yourself
videos.overview: After the sudden death of their older brother and heir to the throne, Prince Liam and Princess Eleanor have a hard time with their new roles. Queen Helena tries to maintain the family's image and King Simon questions the monarchy's future.

videos.title: Infants of the Spring
videos.overview: At the annual garden party, Prince Liam is reunited with his ex, Gemma. The Queen and Cyrus work to counteract King Simon's wishes.

videos.title: We Are Pictures, or Mere Beasts
videos.overview: The Queen and Princess Eleanor throw competing fashion shows during London's fashion week while Prince Liam narrowly avoids a catastrophe.

videos.title: Sweet, Not Lasting
videos.overview: Prince Liam does his first PR tour as heir to the throne while Queen Helena forces Princess Eleanor to do a PR tour of London.

videos.title: Unmask Her Beauty to the Moon
videos.overview: Prince Liam, Princess Eleanor and Queen Helena's romances are a popular topic at the annual masquerade ball.

videos.title: The Slings and Arrows of Outrageous Fortune
videos.overview: A trip to Monaco helps Prince Liam and Ophelia's relationship blossom but a different side of Princess Eleanor is revealed.

videos.title: Your Sovereignty of Reason
videos.overview: The King makes a decision that impacts the rest of the family while Ophelia struggles with the PR fallout from Monaco.

videos.title: The Great Man Down
videos.overview: The Royal Family is put on lockdown in a safe room at the palace after an assassination attempt.

videos.title: In My Heart There Was a Kind of Fighting
videos.overview: When someone from Prince Robert's past pays them a visit, Prince Liam and Princess Eleanor must face their own personal demons.

videos.title: Our Wills and Fates Do So Contrary Run
videos.overview: Secrets are revealed as Prince Liam and Princess Eleanor investigate Prince Robert's death and the attack on the throne.

videos.title: It Is Not, nor It Cannot Come to Good
videos.overview: In the wake of King Simon's death, King Cyrus' new look monarchy is on full display at the Royal polo match, Prince Liam is hell-bent on revenge and receives some unexpected help, and Queen Helena maneuvers for power.

videos.title: Welcome Is Fashion and Ceremony
videos.overview: In Prince Liam's quest for vengeance, a secret is revealed that affects the monarchy's future while Princess Eleanor rekindles an old flame.

videos.title: Is Not This Something More than Fantasy?
videos.overview: Prince Liam and Princess Eleanor both take trips that don't end as they expected, while at home Queen Helena meets a new rival and King Cyrus receives some bad news.

videos.title: What, Has This Thing Appear'd Again Tonight?
videos.overview: King Cyrus draws a line in the sand with Queen Helena and Prince Liam as he does whatever he can to eliminate King Simon's legacy. Princess Eleanor makes a friend as a new wrinkle in the King's murder is potentially revealed.

videos.title: The Spirit That I Have Seen
videos.overview: Princess Eleanor's new relationship makes waves in and outside of the palace as King Cyrus uses a public ceremony to solidify his image and Queen Helena learns of betrayal.

videos.title: Doubt Truth to Be a Liar
videos.overview: The twins have a birthday party in the palace and things get out of hand. Queen Helena and Prince Liam look to the past for answers about the future.

videos.title: Taint Not Thy Mind, nor Let Thy Soul Contrive Against Thy Mother
videos.overview: Queen Helena and Princess Eleanor share some unexpected bonding time as Prince Liam investigates Domino.

videos.title: Be All My Sins Remembered
videos.overview: Relationships are forever changed when The Royals' family history is called in to question.

videos.title: And Then It Started Like a Guilty Thing
videos.overview: Uncertainty abounds as questions of the King's killer come to the forefront and the monarchy's structure is challenged.

videos.title: The Serpent That Did Sting Thy Father's Life
videos.overview: The royal family faces the possibility of the abolition of the monarchy.

videos.title: Together With Remembrance
videos.overview: In the wake of the death of King Simon's murderer, the royal family returns with a fresh perspective. Liam seeks solace in disreputable places, while Prince Robert is revealed to be alive.

videos.title: Passing Through Nature to Eternity
videos.overview: Helena plans to secure proof. Liam begins a new but complicated relationship. Jasper and Eleanor look to the past to inspire their future.

videos.title: Aye, There's the Rub
videos.overview: While under the weather, Helena gets hooked on a reality television program. The true paternity of Liam and Eleanor is revealed at a time when the prince and princess are each focusing on passionate relationships.

videos.title: Our (Late) Dear Brother's Death
videos.overview: Jasper and Eleanor immerse themselves in their relationship while Liam must reappraise his latest tryst, King Cyrus' past pays him a visit and the palace arranges a press conference to announce earth shattering news.

videos.title: Born to Set it Right
videos.overview: On the eve of a very public appearance, the family's private turmoil threatens to go public. Beck returns to the palace with his sights set on Eleanor, and a confrontation with Jasper ensues.

videos.title: More than Kin, and Less than Kind
videos.overview: Christmas comes to the palace. Liam impulsively releases the staff, forcing the family to fend for themselves. A sexual dalliance for Helena has unexpected consequences.

videos.title: The Counterfeit Presentment of Two Brothers
videos.overview: The royals prepare for the People's Gala, where each member of the family is auctioned off for charity. Cyrus initiates a plan to retain his crown. Liam and Robert square off in a charity boxing match.

videos.title: In the Same Figure, Like the King That's Dead
videos.overview: Jasper tries to strike a bargain to protect his past and secure his future. Helena slips away for a romantic trip to Paris. Eleanor participates in a nearly naked tiger run. Liam and Willow try to navigate emotional waters.

videos.title: O, Farewell, Honest Soldier
videos.overview: Eleanor and Queen Helena consider romantic invitations. A Privy Council meets to determine who will reign as the one true King Of England. Jasper reveals to Liam information that presents a new mystery for the monarchy.

videos.title: To Show My Duty in Your Coronation
videos.overview: Liam finds himself in unexpected places, Helena's heart breaks over a recent loss and Jasper makes a final play for Eleanor's heart. Historic changes assure that nothing will ever be the same.

videos.title: How Prodigal the Soul
videos.overview: Robert gains popularity on his coronation tour, while Jasper and Liam have information that could end his reign; Eleanor must choose between returning to Jasper or working abroad with Sebastian.

videos.title: Confess Yourself to Heaven
videos.overview: Cyrus helps Liam gather intel on Robert. A contender emerges as Helena and Willow assess possible brides for Robert. Jasper goes rogue at a press conference, while Eleanor watches.

videos.title: Seek for Thy Noble Father in the Dust
videos.overview: Liam makes a big move with the evidence he has on Robert; Eleanor uses her status to help others; Helena finds herself at the center of a new scandal.

videos.title: Black as His Purpose Did the Night Resemble
videos.overview: A total blackout sparks chaos in London; Willow's feelings for Robert grow stronger; Eleanor opens the palace to the public; Jasper finds himself in the middle of a riot.

videos.title: There's Daggers in Men's Smiles
videos.overview: Robert extends his power further than ever before and exiles a disloyal Cyrus. Eleanor undertakes a covert mission and Helena explores her romantic options.

videos.title: Forgive Me This My Virtue
videos.overview: Eleanor enlists Jasper's help for one of her covert missions. Helena begins a new chapter at a royal event where the press attacks Willow. Cyrus meets an unlikely ally.

videos.title: In the Dead Vast and Middle of the Night
Foul Deeds Will Rise
videos.overview: Liam's true intentions are revealed; Jasper helps Liam with a plan.

videos.title: With Mirth in Funeral and with Dirge in Marriage
videos.overview: The rest of the family unites to combat a formidable foe.
